LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Active Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active Listening, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you pick out vital information during oral communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. create a concept map on vocabulary related to location and directions (e.g. 地方/地点、附近、最近、 近、很近、远、很远、在、方 向、向,朝,往、前、后、左、 右、拐/转),
2. work jointly to explore

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: reflection on one’s work is developed as the learner composes sentences on the theme for peer feedback.

• Communication and Collaboration: the learner listens keenly and actively to retell the main information from a recording.

Values:
Peace: calmness is displayed as the learner takes turns in asking and giving directions using the keywords.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Personal safety is promoted as the learner explores safety measures to consider when asking for directions from others.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Social Studies on the skill of using cardinal points to give directions.
